acceptedFindings: 4:48 constructs 10^position with DWORD LEA/ADD operations and uses signed IDIV without a zero-divisor guard; every completed loop for position>=32 yields divisor zero. Negative positions leave divisor one. No actual target execution or retail reachability witness is claimed.

Counter/combo updates wrap DWORD arithmetic before signed comparisons and clamping. Counter and gauge boundary messages and threshold virtual callbacks occur before their final current-value stores; arbitrary callback effects remain a lifetime boundary.

4:42 is mutating: after its timer-result/counter/latch predicates it may enqueue achievement147, sets latch bit8 even with null achievement context, then increments an unchecked indexed byte only below99. No completed achievement or persistence guarantee is claimed.

Mission result paths can stop the timer, change flags/HUD, stage result phases or dispatch immediately. Cleanup calls script/resource release helpers before nulling the mission global; reconstruction reuses static storage, so pointer equality is not a generation.
